overview.description: The State Street Materials Select Sector SPDR Premium Income ETF (XLBI) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P Materials Select Sector index. The fund is an actively managed fund-of-funds that provides US Materials sector exposure by investing in shares of the Materials Select Sector SPDR Fund (XLB). Additionally, it aims to provide income by selling short-dated call options. XLBI was launched on Jul 29, 2025 and is issued by State Street.
